card_title: Conduct structured pre-visit planning before scheduled visits

owner_steward.name: TBD
owner_steward.role: QI Program Manager, Bipolar Action Network

trigger.description: An upcoming scheduled appointment for a patient being seen today, tomorrow, or this week.

action.description: Generate a standardized PVP report containing recent PROs/MBC metrics, current medications, last contact, and a phase-specific checklist.
Obtain relevant information and arrange any needed lab testing before the visit.
Review the PVP summary, identify care gaps, and assign each gap an owner and due-by date.
Conduct a brief team huddle (10 minutes max) for at-risk patients. Document the plan with explicit owners and next steps.
Use the phase-specific evidence-based checklist during the encounter. Document any deviations with a rationale.
Execute follow-up actions within 72 hours of the visit.

target.description: Patients with bipolar disorder scheduled for an upcoming visit within 72 hours at a BAN network site.
eligibility_criteria: Active bipolar disorder diagnosis in clinic registry
Visit type defined as eligible per local site definition

timing.description: Produce PVP report 24-72 hours before the visit. Review at visit start and/or during same-day huddle. Complete follow-ups within 72 hours post-visit.

operational_definition.summary: A PVP summary is available in the standard location at least 24 hours before the visit, acknowledged at visit start, and used to drive the encounter and close identified care gaps.
fidelity_criteria: PVP summary available at least 24 hours before the visit in the standard location
Summary includes current medications, last contact, latest PRO/MBC metrics, and care gaps
Phase-specific checklist attached and actively used during the encounter
Each identified care gap has an assigned owner and due-by date
Brief huddle conducted for at-risk patients and plan documented
prerequisites: Registry dataset is reliable enough to populate PVP fields
Site has agreed on the list of care components and phase-specific checklists
Site has established a local definition of eligible visits

process_measures.name: PVP availability rate
process_measures.numerator: Eligible visits with PVP summary available at least 24 hours before the visit

process_measures.name: Checklist use rate
process_measures.numerator: Eligible visits with documented use of the evidence-based checklist

process_measures.name: Care gap ownership rate
process_measures.numerator: Identified care gaps with an assigned owner and due-by date
process_measures.denominator: All care gaps identified during PVP review

outcome_measures.name: Remission rate
outcome_measures.numerator: Patients in remission at last eligible visit
outcome_measures.denominator: All patients with an eligible visit in the measurement period

balancing_measures.name: PVP production time
balancing_measures.description: Median staff minutes to produce the PVP report per visit.

balancing_measures.name: Clinician after-hours work time
balancing_measures.description: Median minutes of clinician after-hours work attributable to PVP documentation.
